description: Source code for the Zephyr driver for the STMicroelectronics LIS2MDL 3-axis magnetometer sensor, including initialization, configuration, data fetching, and power management.

methods.name: lis2mdl_set_odr
methods.description: Sets the output data rate for the sensor based on the provided sensor_value.

methods.name: lis2mdl_set_hard_iron
methods.description: Configures the hard iron (offset) calibration for the magnetometer.

methods.name: lis2mdl_channel_get_mag
methods.description: Retrieves the magnetic field data for a specified axis.

methods.name: lis2mdl_channel_get
methods.description: Gets sensor data for specified channel, either magnetic or temperature.

methods.name: lis2mdl_config
methods.description: Configures sensor attributes such as sampling frequency or offset.

methods.name: lis2mdl_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes based on channel and attribute type.

methods.name: get_single_mode_raw_data
methods.description: Fetches raw magnetometer data in single trigger mode.

methods.name: lis2mdl_sample_fetch_mag
methods.description: Fetches magnetometer data, handling single and continuous modes.

methods.name: lis2mdl_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data for specified channels.

methods.name: lis2mdl_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, configures power modes, and verifies device ID.
